description: This Java class defines the CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration, which extends IntegrationConfiguration and implements CustomIntegrationConfiguration, representing configuration data for custom shipping quotes including module code, regions, and JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the configuration for custom shipping quotes, including a list of regional configurations and methods for JSON serialization.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration object into a JSON string, including module code, active status, and regions.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code for this configuration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for this configuration.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the list of region configurations.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of region configurations.
